### molecule/ProductTileFlag

summary: A visual flag component for product tiles highlighting promotional labels like sale, promo, or new items.
features: Multiple variant styles: promo, sale, and new
Global theming for background and text colors
longDescription:
## Purpose

The ProductTileFlag component draws customer attention to special product attributes such as sales, promotions, or new arrivals by displaying prominent visual badges on product tiles.

## Use Cases

- Highlight discounted products with a sale flag during promotional periods
- Mark newly added products to help customers discover recent additions
- Display promotional badges for special offers or limited-time deals
- Apply custom labels through the content slot for unique marketing campaigns
- Maintain visual consistency across product grids and category listings

## Design Rationale

The component uses predefined variants (promo, sale, new) to ensure consistent visual hierarchy across the storefront while allowing global theming customization. Styling matches category node flags for a unified design language. The slot-based content approach enables merchants to customize label text while maintaining the established visual treatment. Figma variables control spacing and appearance to ensure design system compliance.
